mapper.select: select count(*) from notice where (deleted = 0 or deleted is null) and ( #{status} = 'ALL' or (#{status} = 'PIN' and is_pinned = 1) or (#{status} = 'NOPIN' and is_pinned = 0) )

select n.notice_id, n.title, n.created_at, n.is_pinned, n.type, n.admin_id, n.updated_at, u.nickname from notice n left join user u on u.user_id = n.admin_id where (deleted = 0 or deleted is null) and ( #{status} = 'ALL' or (#{status} = 'PIN' and is_pinned = 1) or (#{status} = 'NOPIN' and is_pinned = 0) ) order by notice_id desc limit #{row}, 10
mapper.update: update notice set title = #{title}, type = #{type}, content = #{content}, updated_at = now() where notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert: insert into notice(title, content, created_at, is_pinned, admin_id, type, deleted, updated_at) values (#{title},#{content},now(), #{isPinned},#{adminId},#{type},0,null)

select n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, date_format(n.created_at, '%Y.%m.%d') as created_at, n.is_pinned, n.type, n.admin_id, n.updated_at, u.nickname from notice n left join user u on u.user_id = n.admin_id where (n.deleted = 0 or n.deleted is null) and n.is_pinned = 1
and n.type = #{type}
and (n.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or n.content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by n.notice_id desc
